title: Scaffold an executor inside a workspace plugin
description: Wrap `@nx/plugin:executor` with the workspace conventions: the executor lands at `src/lib/executors/<directory>/executor.ts` in the target plugin, with a type-checked `schema.ts` exporting an `Options` interface, a strict `schema.json`, a minimal starter and spec, a README, and a re-export from the plugin's `src/index.ts`.

examples.description: Adds an executor whose folder (`swa-deploy/`) differs from its collection key (`deploy`).

name.description: The executor name — its key in the target plugin's executors collection and, unless `directory` overrides it, its folder under `src/lib/executors/`. Lowercase alphanumeric words joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter (it becomes part of TypeScript identifiers).

project.description: The plugin project to add the executor to. Must be tagged `type:plugin`.
project.x-prompt: Which plugin project should the executor be added to?

directory.description: Folder segment under the plugin's `src/lib/executors/`. Defaults to `name`; set it when the folder should differ from the collection key.

description.description: Executor description, recorded in the plugin's `executors.json`, the executor's `schema.json` and its README.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner for the generated executor's spec. The workspace standardizes on Jest (ADR 0007).

skipLintChecks.description: Do not add an eslint configuration for the plugin's json files.
